{{Quote|Go to the cantina and speak with Herman Pate. He has my ring. He's not a bad guy, but for some reason he hasn't ever returned my ring and seems to always avoid the subject. Herman is usually at the cantina.|[[Vance Groten]], to a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]]|<ref name="SWG:DVGaF" />}}
'''Herman Pate''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He lived at [[Dee'ja Peak/Legends|Dee'ja Peak]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="SWG:DVGaF" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> he won a ring from [[Vance Groten]] during a [[Sabacc/Legends|Sabacc]] game. Pate later gave the ring to [[Janelle]], a [[Mountaintop smugglers|smuggler]] leader, to pay a debt. As the ring was a family heirloom, Groten later tried to pay Pate to recover the ring but it was not in his own anymore. Vance Groten finally dispatched a spacer to find the smuggler leader Janelle and get the ring back.<ref name="SWG:DVGaF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Herman Pate appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DVGaF" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Herman Pate was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
